semantic_reason: The PR fixes a reported defect (#145) where starting the :protobuf application was not idempotent: restarting after stop crashed because :persistent_term entries were not cleared on shutdown. The change adds an Application.stop/1 callback that calls __unload_extensions__/0 to erase extension keys from :persistent_term, restoring correct restart behavior. This corrects existing broken behavior rather than introducing new functionality; the removal of the GlobalStore wrapper and OTP 21 support are incidental cleanups.
delegation_note: Defect-semantics review remains agent-delegated; patch minimization was separately confirmed by the human dataset curator on 2026-09-12.
